basic_info.description: Nestled in the heart of San Francisco's coveted Central Sunset district, this charming 2 bedroom, 1.5 bath main home showcases timeless character with original hardwood floors, an abundance of natural light, skylights, and vintage touches throughout. Fresh interior paint and new kitchen flooring make this home ready to move in and enjoy as-is, or a fantastic canvas for your own personal touches. The expansive backyard is perfect for gardening, entertaining, or creating your own urban oasis.    A fantastic opportunity for homeowners and investors alike, this property features three separate living units. In addition to the main home, the spacious downstairs 1 bedroom, 1 bath unit is vacant, providing flexibility for rental income, a home office, or multi-generational living. A vertical addition to the home features a tenant occupied studio, with steady monthly rental income.    Located just blocks from Golden Gate Park, vibrant Irving Street shops and restaurants, and excellent public transit, this home is positioned in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods. With a strong sense of community, nearby top-rated schools, and easy access to downtown and the beach, this is an incredible opportunity to own a piece of classic San Francisco with endless potential.
